caption: The object in the image is a decorative ceramic plate with a central black-and-white illustrated scene and a detailed border. The center features a pastoral scene showing a man on horseback, a person kneeling next to another figure on the ground, a third standing figure, and a two-story house in the background with trees and mountains behind it. The border of the plate is adorned with large, detailed floral patterns and clusters of leaves. Around the top half of the border are four oval medallions, each containing a portrait of a different man, rendered in the same black-and-white style; names are visible above or below the portraits. The bottom section of the border contains an illustration of a building or monument, with additional small text. The overall color of the plate appears to be white or light in the background, with the illustrations and designs in dark, possibly black, ink or glaze. The composition is symmetrical and organized, with decorative and figurative elements combined.
title: Plate - "Niagara"
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
